title: Eric Davis says the head of crash retrieval refused to talk

tellings.quote: Well, I would love to talk to the head of the crash retrieval program during that era, but he refused to talk to us.

plain: The physicist Eric W. Davis says that in the 2000s he wanted to question the head of the crash retrieval program, an alleged secret effort to recover crashed unknown craft, but "he refused to talk to us." Davis tells this to Michels and ties the story to Glenn Gaffney. If true, the program had a known leader who chose silence.
